title: Maps
description: Cross-platform map view (react-native-maps on native, Google Maps JS on web) with location permission helpers.

EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY.description: Google Maps API key for web + native map tiles (enable Maps JavaScript API)

EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_MAP_ID.description: Optional Google Maps map ID (advanced markers / styling)

notes: Requires a development build for native maps (not Expo Go for full Google Maps config).
Not included in starters by default — add with `radiance add maps`.
